what_it_is: A print magazine about the people behind niche music scenes worldwide, built on long candid interviews and photography shot in subjects' homes and studios. Issues also carry archival ephemera features, illustrations and supplement booklets. It is for record collectors, DJs and readers interested in where music meets art and fashion.
